title: Blizzard beta development notes, 27 Oct 2026 (racial additions)

records.notes: Published in Blizzard's WoW Forever Beta development notes; the notes describe the beta client. Whether the release client matches, and the in-game effective date and build, are not verified. These additions were announced on 2026-10-27 as items that had been intended for the 2026-10-26 list.

ops.summary: Cooldown reduced back to 2 minutes (it was 3).

set.description: Increases casting and attack speed by 10% for 15 seconds.

previous.description: Increases casting and attack speed by 10% for 10 seconds.

ops.summary: Internal cooldown reduced from 25 to 15 seconds.

set.description: Increases Mana and Health regeneration by 50%. Cannot be used while Innervate is active, and Innervate replaces it as the more powerful effect. Using it at a ley line also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the regeneration bonus to 100% and persists through death. Attuned is removed when you enter a raid.

ops.summary: Clarified: Attuned is removed when you enter a raid.

previous.description: Increases Mana and Health regeneration by 50%. Cannot be used while Innervate is active, and Innervate replaces it as the more powerful effect. Using it at a ley line also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the regeneration bonus to 100% and persists through death.

set.description: Increases movement speed by 15%. Using it at an elemental convergence also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the speed bonus to 30% and persists through death. Charged is removed when you enter a raid.
